page.title: Meet our faculty
page.intro: INNOVATE 2027 brings together physicians, nurses, and industry leaders who share a passion for scientific discovery, clinical excellence, and the ideas transforming aesthetic medicine.
page.moreComingNote: Stay tuned as we reveal more exciting speakers and industry-leading experts joining the INNOVATE 2027 lineup!

speakers.name: Dr. Arjang Yazdani, MD, FRCSC
speakers.bio: Dr. Arjang Yazdani is a Royal College-certified plastic surgeon with nearly two decades of experience and a passion for advancing the art and science of aesthetic surgery. Specializing in minimally invasive surgical techniques for the face, breast, and body, he is dedicated to refining procedures that deliver exceptional, natural-looking results while minimizing recovery time. A graduate of McMaster University, Dr. Yazdani completed his plastic surgery residency at Western University, followed by advanced fellowship training at the University of Texas Southwestern in Dallas. An accomplished surgeon, educator, and published researcher, he brings a unique combination of surgical expertise, scientific curiosity, and a commitment to continuous learning.

speakers.name: Nadine Sabino, RN, BScN
speakers.role: Advanced Laser Specialist | Educator | Co-Founder, INNOVATE Conference
speakers.bio: Nadine Sabino is one of the leading aesthetic nurses in Canada, as well as a laser specialist and educator with a passion for pushing the boundaries of non-surgical aesthetic medicine. With a career that began in surgical nursing, she has become a sought-after speaker and trainer, sharing her expertise in laser technologies, energy-based devices, injectables, and advanced treatment techniques with practitioners across Canada. As a partner at Yazdani Aesthetics and YASA Laser, Nadine combines extensive hands-on experience with an insatiable curiosity for emerging technologies and the science behind them. Known for challenging conventional approaches and continually seeking better ways to achieve exceptional patient outcomes, she is equally passionate about advancing education and elevating clinical standards.

speakers.name: Ario Khoshbin
speakers.bio: Canadian entrepreneur and founder of Prollenium Medical Technologies, the global manufacturer behind the Revanesse® line of dermal fillers distributed in more than 80 countries. He also founded Phiusion Labs, an innovation platform focused on next-generation technologies in aesthetics, biologics, and regenerative medicine.
speakers.talkTitle: Regenerative Aesthetics and the End of Symptomology
speakers.talkDescription: Drawing on decades building Prollenium from a startup into a global injectable manufacturer — and on Phiusion Labs’ work in next-generation aesthetics and regenerative medicine — Ario Khoshbin explores how regenerative approaches can move the field beyond treating surface symptoms toward deeper, biology-driven outcomes. The session connects product innovation, R&D, and clinical practice around a central question: what does aesthetic medicine look like when regeneration, not symptom management, sets the agenda?

speakers.name: Kimsy Kay, RPN
speakers.bio: Founder of Empower Aesthetic Medicine Collaborative (EAMC) and Executive Producer of Nurses & Needles, a Canadian educational conference series advancing clinical preparedness and professional development in aesthetic medicine. With a nursing background across community care, research, education, and aesthetics, Kimsy advocates for education over ego and keeping patient safety at the centre of practice.
speakers.talkTitle: Beyond the Treatment: Clinical Preparedness in Modern Aesthetic Medicine
speakers.talkDescription: As aesthetic medicine rapidly embraces new technologies, products, and regenerative treatments, clinical systems must evolve alongside them. Kimsy Kay, RPN, explores the fundamentals surrounding innovation - from patient assessment, consent and documentation to complication preparedness, interdisciplinary collaboration, and knowing when not to treat. The session asks practitioners to consider a critical question: As our treatments become more advanced, are our clinical systems advancing with them?

speakers.name: Dr. Michael Roskies
speakers.bio:
Dr. Michael Roskies is a double fellowship trained, double board certified facial plastic and reconstructive surgeon and owner of Yorkville Plastic Surgery Center. He trained in microvascular reconstruction at the prestigious Cleveland Clinic, where he worked alongside the pioneers of face transplantation, and further refined his techniques in Facial Plastic Surgery at the University of Toronto. During five years of training at McGill University in General Surgery, Plastic Surgery and Otolaryngology-Head & Neck Surgery, he also obtained a Master’s degree in Tissue Engineering.

His practice focuses exclusively on cosmetic surgery of the face, with over 15,000 hours spent operating on this body region throughout his career. An early adopter of preservation rhinoplasty and ultrasonic rhinoplasty, Dr. Roskies is one of the few surgeons to combine these innovations worldwide. He has also performed hundreds of hair transplants and is a leader in non-surgical rejuvenation. Recently selected as a “Leader of the Future” by industry pioneers, he is frequently invited to speak on injectable fillers, neurotoxins and facial anatomy.

speakers.name: Dr. Jamil Ahmad
speakers.role: Board-Certified Plastic Surgeon | President, The Aesthetic Society
speakers.bio:
Dr. Jamil Ahmad is a board-certified plastic surgeon and one of the most recognized figures in aesthetic surgery in North America. Trained at the University of Texas Southwestern Medical Center in Dallas, he has been in practice in Mississauga since 2010, building a reputation defined by natural results, surgical precision, and an uncompromising standard of care. He holds an appointment as Assistant Professor at the University of Toronto’s Temerty Faculty of Medicine.

Dr. Ahmad currently serves as President of The Aesthetic Society, and is the Past President of both the Canadian Society for Aesthetic Plastic Surgery and the Rhinoplasty Society. A globally sought-after educator, he has delivered over 500 invited lectures worldwide and has authored more than 200 peer-reviewed articles and book chapters. He is co-editor of the 3rd and 4th editions of Dallas Rhinoplasty: Nasal Surgery by the Masters — the field’s definitive reference text, recognized globally as the essential guide to rhinoplasty surgery — alongside companion volumes on secondary rhinoplasty and surgical dissection technique.

His practice philosophy mirrors the standard he has helped set for the field: individualized care, evidence-based decisions, and results that are consistent, refined, and entirely natural.

Through True Plastic Surgery, Dr. Ahmad brings fifteen years of practice and a lifetime of leadership in aesthetic surgery to every patient encounter.
